title: Enjoy a round of Blade Volley
author: ddsky
selftext:
Game Title: Blade Volley  
Playable Link: [https://revere.games/bladevolley/](https://revere.games/bladevolley/)

[Mobile controls](https://preview.redd.it/q6iq6q9ph6kh1.png?width=2504&format=png&auto=webp&s=8cb9fe8e13ab12053bd030de04307dc6639e8863)

  
Description: You play a "blade baller" against six opponents. Each have their own unique play style and character. The fun is in the taunts.

I'm developing this free game for my cousin who's having a hard time in his life right now. He loves volleyball so I thought I'd surprise him with a game tailored to him.

I'd love to get some feedback on the difficulty level and on how you get on with the controls. The game allows for keyboard+ mouse / touch on mobile (hardest in my opinion) and controller (easiest).

I'm a solo developer and used AI to help me create the game.  
AI for images, music, some sound effects (GPT image 2, Suno, Eleven Labs). 

Claude Code for lots of coding and orchestration (mostly Opus 5 xhigh).

The hardest part was getting the AI to do the animations. Maybe I approached this completely wrong but I started with an SVG and let the AI rig that. Then I just Frankensteined other heads on the rigged body. If anybody knows a better way, I'm all ears!
